Current side plans for myself other than this mod is to introduce the S&W 686 revolver Including grips, barrel lengths and muzzle devices. And maybe a .500 SW revolver as well.

Basing mods around what a gunsmith with a moderate amount of skill could actually do. But this current mod is a very large undertaking so that is where I’m focusing around right now.

comments.body_html:
for the first question, honestly a lot of weapons in tarkov, that have kinda just been added and they’ve never properly changed, like the Tokarev, VPO-101, and the AKs, mostly models the devs haven’t updated in like 5 years, no need in overhauls or recoil changes, but I’ve been staring at the same M4/AK model for so long it haunts my dreams.
and for the second one, an idea for a pretty light-weight mod, the TOZ-106 irl can have a much longer barrel mostly for commercial use like hunting and competition, the one in game is the self-defense variant, so maybe like a 16in (406mm) or 20in (508mm) barrel that can be equipped along with the accompanying stock, perhaps greatly improving MOA, but weighs it down much more making ergonomics much lower.

if you’d like I can send you a yt link that does an overview of the gun that could work well for a reference
